description: Audit a GitHub repository's dependencies for reachable vulnerabilities: I'll give you the repository's address each time. Read its manifests and lockfiles (package.json and package-lock.json, go.mod, requirements.txt, pom.xml), look up each pinned version's known advisories, check whether the code actually calls the vulnerable functions, and write a report ranking each finding by whether it is reachable, with the file and line that reaches it and the version that fixes it.
